findings.actualProblem: The legend defines all green arrows as food to consumer. Two green arrows from the oak tree to its own oak leaf and acorns instead connect an organism to its parts/products, which is no food-to-consumer relationship. The leaf-to-caterpillar, caterpillar-to-tit, acorn-to-mouse, consumers-to-owl and litter-to-decomposers paths are coherent.
findings.boundedCorrection: Remove the tree-to-leaf and tree-to-acorn arrowheads/feeding-style connectors, retain leaves/acorns as oak food sources. Alternatively clearly distinguish plant production arrows from feeding arrows without adding illegible small text.

findings.actualProblem: In the actual 360px image the diagram axis label Photosyntheserate is only a few pixels high and cannot be read reliably; Temperatur in the same inset is also very small. These labels define the scientific meaning of the plotted bell curve. The main plant/site motifs and large factor labels remain clear.
findings.boundedCorrection: Keep the current illustration and schematic curve; enlarge or simplify scientifically essential curve-axis labels, for example a large Fotosynthese/Rate title and legible Temperatur label, or increase inset allocation. Retain the Schema marker and avoid adding measured-data or ecological-potency experiment claims. Check actual 360/680 afterwards.
